title: What if you went to space without a suit? 🚀
subject: astronaut
description:
Would you exhale or hold your breath? 👇

What really happens to the human body in the vacuum of space without a spacesuit? No exploding, no boiling blood, but a very short clock, and a real NASA vacuum chamber accident.

Sources: NASA Imagine the Universe (Ask an Astrophysicist), University of Houston Engines of Our Ingenuity, Space.com
tags: what if you went to space without a suit
what happens in space without a suit
how long can you survive in space

scenes.text: Without a spacesuit in space, you get 15 seconds.
Not to live. To stay awake, before oxygen-starved blood reaches your brain.
First, exhale. Hold your breath and the expanding air tears your lungs.
But here's the strange part. You don't explode, and your blood doesn't boil.
Back in air within a minute, scientists think you'd likely survive. A NASA test subject did when his suit leaked in a vacuum chamber.
